messages:
maria-cs: Heads up — Calyx Health pilot starts Mon 9am PT. Need to lock enablement + weekly feedback cadence. Who can own the kickoff and the short feedback capture? :calendar:
aj-sales: I can join kickoff for contract context. Renewal milestone is in 9 months, want to capture early signals. Can AE own renewal risk notes? :thinking_face:
devon-cust: Devon here (Calyx) — availability Mon 9–11am PT works. We'll need a QA account and a sanitized dataset; legal flagged PII last week. Can you confirm test data path?
sam-pm: Re feedback, propose 2 parts: 1) short 3-question form after each session, 2) weekly quick sync w/ Calyx champion for qualitative notes. Draft form link: https://forms.redwood.internal/lighthouse-pilot (WIP)
priya-cs: I can run the enablement session Mon 9:15am PT. I'll include a 15m setup + 30m walkthrough + 15m Q&A. Will capture session notes in the pilot doc. @aj-sales can you join the first 10 mins for intro? :slightly_smiling_face:
aj-sales: yep, I'll jump on for the intro. Could we also add a short item to call agenda to surface any legal/data blockers? keeps renewal risk visible.
maria-cs: @priya-cs + @sam-pm love it. @devon-cust we'll DM on the sanitized dataset path. I'll create a recurring calendar for the weekly feedback sync.
pilot-bot: Reminder created — "Calyx Lighthouse: weekly pilot sync" every Mon 9:00 PT starting 3067894920. Invitees: maria-cs, priya-cs, aj-sales, devon-cust, sam-pm.
priya-cs: For the post-session form, here's the 3 questions I want: 1) Were the outputs relevant? (Y/N) 2) Any data/permission blockers? (brief) 3) One improvement request. I'll wire this into the form and add to the calendar invite.
sam-pm: I'll map those to metrics: relevance_rate, blocker_flag_count, top_request themes. Will proto a small dashboard widget in Console for the pilot route.
maria-cs: Action items: Priya = run enablement + post-session form, Sam = dashboard + form link finalization, Aj = intro + renewal risk notes, Maria = calendar + dataset sync. Devon = confirm dataset access by EOD Fri. :point_down:
devon-cust: Confirmed — will share S3 test bucket path and sanitized schema by EOD Fri. Thanks team.
priya-cs: Great. Quick note — let's capture an NPS pulse at week 3 and a short success story quote at week 6 for marketing. :rocket:
maria-cs: Agree. I'll add NPS to the week 3 agenda and request a short quote collection at week 6.
aj-sales: Logging renewal risk as low-medium for now, will update if blockers appear.
maria-cs: Thanks all — I'll post the pilot doc and invite in the channel shortly. :white_check_mark:
